[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Anstaal''' was a wealthy aristocrat during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of the galaxy's richest men, he employed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[A2-B4]] as his advisor.
